lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {gravemaw_bearer} does not sharpen his sword. He only sits with it across his knees.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: It goes quiet when it's fed. That's worse.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: The bearer before me was a farmer. They hanged him in his own yard. I held the rope.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: And then you took the sword.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: It took me. I just didn't argue.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: He holds the rope still. Ask him why he carries it.
